candidates.change_summary: Change totalSupply to return totalSupply - 1, altering the observable return value.
Delete the statement that increments mapSynth_LPBalance[msg.sender].
Credit LP balance to `member` instead of `msg.sender`.
Overwrite instead of accumulate: use `=` for mapSynth_LPBalance[msg.sender].
Move the LP-balance update before reading `_getAddedLPAmount`, so the added LP amount computes to zero.
Invert the check to require the caller NOT be a curated pool, so legitimate pool calls revert and unrelated callers pass.
Check curated status of tx.origin instead of msg.sender, changing which callers are permitted.
Change debt accumulation to assignment so mapSynth_LPDebt[msg.sender] is overwritten instead of incremented.
Delete the statement that increases mapSynth_LPDebt[msg.sender], so debt is never recorded.
Record the debt under the member key instead of the pool (msg.sender) key.
Add lpUnits to the debt mapping instead of amount, changing the recorded debt value.
